title: What If You Accelerated at 1G for a Whole Year?

scenes.text: What if a spaceship accelerated at one g for a year? You'd feel normal weight the whole time.
One g is Earth's gravity. Keep pushing at it, and you gain about ten meters per second, every second.
After one year on the ship's clock, you'd be moving at roughly seventy-seven percent of the speed of light.
Back on Earth, the trip would have covered about half a light-year.
Now accelerate halfway and brake the other half. You could cross the Milky Way in about twelve years of your own time.
But on Earth, about a hundred thirteen thousand years would pass. You'd arrive, and everyone you knew would be long gone.
